text:
Not yet. The 2025 loss is a detected candidate, but it is not confirmed or shown to be persistent.

- **What is observed:** Hansen/UMD maps about 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025 (3.91% of the 345.6 ha asset). JRC 2020 shows forest over 98% of that area. The MGAP 2021 map classes about 13.1 ha as native forest and none as planted.
- **Why it is not confirmed:** The status is "pending corroboration." 2025 is the latest year in the series, and no later year has been observed for this event. The corroboration rule requires a later year as well as JRC agreement of at least 50%. The JRC condition is met, but the later-year condition is not.

Persistence can only be checked once 2026 data is available. Even then, this evidence would not show deforestation, cause, legality, or who was responsible. Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, and the native forest map gives context only.
